 _NON_WORD = re.compile(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+")
+_MD_CODE = re.compile(r"`([^`]*)`")
+_MD_STRONG = re.compile(r"(\*\*|__)(?=\S)(.+?)(?<=\S)\1")
+_MD_EM_STAR = re.compile(r"\*(?=\S)([^*]+?)(?<=\S)\*")
+_MD_EM_UNDER = re.compile(r"(?<!\w)_(?=\S)([^_]+?)(?<=\S)_(?!\w)")

+
+def strip_markdown(text: str) -> str:
+    """'**bold** and _it_ and `code`' -> 'bold and it and code'."""
+    text = _MD_CODE.sub(r"\1", text)
+    text = _MD_STRONG.sub(r"\2", text)
+    text = _MD_EM_STAR.sub(r"\1", text)
+    return _MD_EM_UNDER.sub(r"\1", text)
